caption:
Follow me @natestav for more.
‎
Michael Burry just mapped how Nvidia booked $5.4B in revenue by selling chips to a shell company it helped fund. The chips disappeared from every balance sheet. The risk ended up with retirees. He called it fugazi. Every step is legal. That’s the problem.
‎
I’m not a financial advisor and I’m not telling you to buy anything.
‎
Hate the market with me.
video_overlay_text_observed: Cover card: 'NVIDIA SOLD $5.4B IN CHIPS TO A COMPANY THAT DIDN'T EXIST UNTIL JANUARY'; lower-third 'SOLD 5.4 BILLION'; an on-screen text panel paraphrasing Burry's pipeline (GB200 GPUs → Valor Compute Infrastructure, Nvidia anchoring the SPV).
audio_content_summary: Walkthrough of Michael Burry's 'Fugazi' critique of the Nvidia/Valor/Apollo/Athene/xAI financing chain: Nvidia sold ~$5.4B of GB200 chips to Valor Compute Infrastructure (a January-2026 SPV), invested $1.9B back into it, booked the sale as revenue; chips run in Musk's xAI data center; Apollo arranged ~$3.5B debt securitized to Athene, whose annuity holders end up carrying AI-infrastructure credit risk; Burry's reading of Athene's Bermuda captive ($217B offshore, ~34.7% Level 3, ~16x leverage) framed as the 2008 playbook. Speaker repeatedly notes every step is legal and disclosed and that Burry is not alleging fraud.
implied_frame: Frames the deal as deliberate fraud-adjacent concealment ('a company that doesn't exist', 'nobody technically owns it', 'NVIDIA funded its own buyer'). The disclosed structure and Burry's published critique are real (record 2026-nvidia-valor-burry-001); the alarming offshore/leverage figures are Burry's own reading of Athene's disclosures, and the 'circular financing / risk dumped on retirees / 2008 redux' thesis is contested — Nvidia's analyst memo denies SPV use and circular financing. Attributed, not adopted.
capture_method: Pristine original media + metadata pulled from Instagram's CDN via yt-dlp; delivery webm derived once (VP9 video copied, audio normalized to -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP off the source AAC — no re-recording, no in-place re-encode).
video_download_status: Original pulled via yt-dlp (~19.8 MB); delivery ~20.6 MB webm, 157s.
